$comment: Machine-readable per-file index for LLM retrieval. Keep in sync with docs/codebase-overview.md.

files.summary: Core distiller owning napmem_pyramid.json: extract_atomic_units (8-way taxonomy heuristics), deduplicate_and_merge (exact-text fold with duplicate_anchors), _reconcile_session_records (stable IDs across re-ingestion, duplicate promotion), rebuild_higher_layers (tracks + profiles), atomic save, CLI.

Background consolidator: scans watch dir for .md files, re-ingests on content change (mtime fast-path + persistent sha256 sweep-state in <pyramid>.sweepstate.json — touched-but-unchanged files skip extraction across --once restarts), per-file OSError/UnicodeDecodeError isolation, extraction chain auto = anthropic -> ollama -> heuristic, polling loop with max-ticks, CLI.

Read-only retrieval tools: search_memory_pyramid (layer-scoped, ValueError on bad layer), inspect_provenance (resolves canonical and duplicate IDs), get_topic_track, compute_context_budget_savings (discloses missing raw files), CLI.

Zero-fabrication LLM extraction prompt: untrusted-content + zero-fabrication guards, sentinel delimiter with loop neutralization (_neutralize_sentinel), newline-stripped metadata interpolation (_neutralize_metadata), get_extraction_prompt.

Production LLM extraction: get_extraction_prompt -> Anthropic Message Batches API (claude-haiku-4-5 default) or direct call, parse_extraction_output (fence-tolerant), validate_unit schema gate, units_to_records, ingest via distiller.ingest_session_records. Optional anthropic dependency, lazy import.

Zero-API-cost extraction backend: NAPMEM_OLLAMA_CHAT url=model host chain, Ollama /api/chat json-mode with per-sweep dead-host benching and wrapped-object coercion; reuses the sentinel extraction prompt and llm_extractor's parse/validate gauntlet unchanged.

SemanticIndex: per-record embedding cache (<pyramid>.embindex.json, keyed id+text hash), cosine search, nearest_record_id for semantic dedup. Backends: OllamaBackend (localhost /api/embed, auto-probe) and HashedTfBackend (stdlib hashed TF). NAPMEM_EMBED_BACKEND forces choice.

Pure-stdlib MCP stdio server (newline JSON-RPC 2.0, protocol 2025-06-18): initialize/tools list/tools call; tools search_memory (substring+semantic), inspect_provenance, get_topic_track, memory_stats. Store re-read per call; in-band isError for tool failures.
9 unittest tests: extraction typing/salience, dedup + duplicate anchors, re-ingestion ID stability, duplicate promotion, layer rebuild, provenance, sentinel neutralization.

10 unittest tests, network-free: extractor parse/validate/convert + LLM-record re-ingest stability, hashed-backend cosine, semantic search ranking, semantic dedup fold and off-by-default, MCP handshake/tools/errors via subprocess.

Portable bash sweep wrapper (launchd + systemd): mirrors Claude/Antigravity/mounted-twin memory files as prefixed symlinks, skips sync-conflict copies, refuses+revokes out-of-root sources, exports NAPMEM_ALLOWED_ROOTS, runs one consolidation sweep.
systemd oneshot user service for one sweep; pool weights for the Linux 5080 box; paired with hourly Persistent timer.
Fleet topology (Linux canonical consolidator, M5 pool member, M3 ssh-MCP client), data flow, 3-layer security model, full 2026-08-20 build history.
JSON Schema for the pyramid store: layers 0-3 shapes, record fields, profile category enum.
Example pyramid store produced from sample data.
